entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: A pivotal conflict around 4100 AR in the secluded valley of Tamingazin, in which treachery, civil war and a Suder invasion transformed the valley.

entities.name: Tamingazin
entities.description: A secluded valley subcontinent protected by the Magewall, home to humans, Garan elves and Viashino.

entities.name: Magewall
entities.description: A powerful magical barrier that slowed any invading force to a crawl and protected Tamingazin.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: The magical artifact that sustained the valley's defenses; stolen by Aligarius Timni.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: The human leader who united the valley under a single rule and was assassinated on the day he declared himself King and Bey.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: The last independent city of the valley, ruled by the Viashino.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: The wizards on the central mountain who had sworn not to interfere in valley affairs.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: A bored, ambitious mage who subdued Berimish for Tagard, was addicted to Suder drugs, stole the Magewall Hub, and finally restored the Magewall.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Tagard's general and second-in-command who seized power after his death, conspiring with the Suder.

entities.name: Rael Gar
entities.description: The Garan elf leader who had usurped his position by exiling Recin's mother; he was killed in the fighting.

entities.name: Lisolo
entities.description: The former Viashino ruler of Berimish, who became an equal on the new governing council.

entities.name: Tallibeth Tarngold
entities.description: Tagard's daughter, who rallied the resistance and emerged as rightful ruler of Tamingazin.

entities.name: Recin
entities.description: An exiled Garan elf raised among the Viashino, befriended by Tallibeth and falsely blamed for Tagard's murder.

entities.name: Janin
entities.description: Recin's mother, exiled by Rael Gar.

entities.name: Samet
entities.description: Rael Gar's successor, who reinstated Recin's family among the elves.

entities.name: Kitrin
entities.description: A young wizard who went with Recin to recover the Magewall Hub.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: A nation that long coveted Tamingazin, conspired with Karelon and invaded the valley.

entities.name: En'Jaga
entities.description: Monstrous warriors unleashed by the Suder in the invasion.

entities.name: Great Marsh
entities.description: A marsh in Tamingazin where Recin and Kitrin were captured.

entities.name: Garan elves
entities.description: One of the valley's three dominant peoples.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: One of the valley's three dominant peoples, ruling the city of Berimish.

events.summary: Tagard Tarngold climbs the central mountain to petition the Institute of Arcane Study, and Aligarius Timni agrees to help.
events.quote: he climbed the mountain at the center of the valley to petition the Institute of Arcane Study for aid

events.summary: Timni subdues Berimish's defenses, letting Tagard take the city and the entire valley without a battle.
events.quote: Using magic, Timni subdued Berimish’s defenses

events.summary: Tagard forms a ruling council with all three races over strong opposition, while Tallibeth befriends Recin.
events.quote: Tagard formed a ruling council that included representatives from all three races, despite strong opposition.

events.summary: Tagard is assassinated with a Viashino crossbow on the day he declares himself King and Bey.
events.quote: he was assassinated — shot with a Viashino crossbow in an apparent act of racial revenge

events.summary: Karelon seizes power, blames Recin and wages war on the Viashino.
events.quote: Karelon, seized power and blamed the murder on Recin

events.summary: Timni, manipulated by Suder drug addiction, steals the Magewall Hub and defects to the Suder.
Tallibeth rallies a resistance allied with Lisolo and the Viashino and overthrows Karelon; Rael Gar is killed and his usurpation revealed.
events.quote: Through bitter fighting, they overthrew Karelon, but not before suffering heavy losses.

events.summary: Recin and Kitrin set out to recover the Magewall Hub, are captured in the Great Marsh, and are helped to escape by Timni.
events.quote: They were captured in the Great Marsh

events.summary: The Suder launch their invasion with thousands of soldiers and En'Jaga warriors.
events.quote: the Suder launched their invasion, unleashing thousands of soldiers and monstrous En'Jaga warriors into Tamingazin

events.summary: Timni restores the Magewall at the last moment, cutting off the invasion and saving the valley.
events.quote: Aligarius Timni restored the Magewall, cutting off the invasion and saving the valley at the last possible moment.

events.summary: Tallibeth emerges as rightful ruler, with Lisolo an equal on the new council.
events.quote: Tallibeth Tarngold emerged as the rightful ruler of Tamingazin

relations.note: Karelon was Tagard's general and second-in-command before betraying him.
Karelon secretly conspired with the Suder.
relations.quote: She had secretly conspired with the nation of Suderbod

relations.note: Timni defected to the Suder after being manipulated with their drugs.
relations.quote: defected to the Suder, giving them the means to disable the wall and invade
through their friendship, she began to overcome her own biases

relations.note: Tallibeth forged an alliance with Lisolo and the Viashino.
relations.quote: forging an unlikely alliance with Lisolo and the Viashino

relations.note: Samet succeeded Rael Gar as Garan elf leader.
relations.quote: His successor Samet reinstated Recin’s family among the elves

relations.note: Rael Gar usurped leadership by exiling Recin's mother.
relations.quote: he had usurped his leadership position years earlier by exiling Recin’s mother
